summary: Iteration 9: Independent verification of the 'Sundered Span' vertical-slice combat showcase. Ran python -m tactical.verify (62/62/0 PASS, FOUNDATION STABLE), full pre-existing backend suite (194/194 passed), and wrote a NEW independent pytest module test_showcase_independent_t1_iter9.py (22 tests, 22 passed) covering static pillar structure, solution levers (elevation, flank/backstab, prepare/OA, burn ignition, focus/sustain), playability across 20 seeds vs both-AI ambush, AI personality expression, world_state persistence, and manifest completeness. Combined backend suite is 216/216 green.
critical_code_review_comments: Positive: pillar_manifest() provides a single source of truth mapping the 15 canonical pillars to feature+decision — excellent for design review coherence.
Positive: Battlefield.persist(world_state) cleanly writes scorched/altered tiles into ws['tactical']['persistent'][battlefield_id], preserving world evolution across combats.

Nit: Combatant.pos is a read-only property. Tests / callers must set .x/.y AND update tile.occupant. Consider a helper Combatant.set_pos(bf, x, y) to keep occupant map in sync and prevent subtle bugs.

Nit: Battlefield.step_environment() (self-only) and CombatEngine.environment_reacts() have overlapping intent; naming should be clarified in docs — engine-level environment_reacts() is the correct public API in tests.

Nit: tactician_controller._priority checks `"rally" in unit.equipped` for the commander branch; consider also checking "war_cry" so the same priority is stable if the warlord ever only carries war_cry.

measured_playability.naive_both_ai_30_seeds: player 0, enemy 30, draw 0 — ambush punishes button-mashing as designed
measured_playability.round_cap: All 20 test seeds resolved decisively within 40 rounds

verified_solution_levers.high_ground: compute_hit_chance(elevation modifier) rises from 0.0 (plains) to 0.1 (hill (5,4)); chance strictly higher.
verified_solution_levers.flank_backstab: Rogue rear backstab vs armoured Warlord strictly out-damages a front basic (punches through armour 5).
verified_solution_levers.prepare_reactions: Guardian prepared counter fires on adjacent raider; moving out of Corrupted Raider (melee, range 1) reach provokes an opportunity attack (Bridge Warden reach 2 correctly does NOT provoke).
verified_solution_levers.burn: Firebolt on the Warlord (standing on oil at (9,2)) ignites tile.env['burning'] and chips HP over subsequent environment_reacts() ticks.
verified_solution_levers.focus_and_sustain: Shaman has armour 1, max_hp 22 (killable priority); healing_potion via actions.use_item restores HP and is consumed.
verified_solution_levers.commander_ai_expression: Across seeds 1..10 driven by tactician_controller, Warlord Gruk uses rally/war_cry at least once.

seed_data_creation: None — used deterministic random.Random(seed) and a FixedRandom-style stub (rng.random()->0.0, rng.randint(a,b)->b) for damage/hit determinism.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Independent test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_showcase_independent_t1_iter9.py. Combatant.pos is read-only — set unit.x/unit.y directly and, when moving mid-test, also update eng.bf.tile(x,y).occupant. Environment ticks use eng.environment_reacts() (engine-level), NOT eng.bf.step_environment(). Tile fire status is tile.env['burning']. Persistence: call eng.start(); ...; eng.end() so that Battlefield.persist(world_state) is invoked; scorched tiles appear under world_state['tactical']['persistent'][showcase.BATTLEFIELD_ID]. Facing values are cardinal strings ('N','S','E','W'), NOT tuples. Opportunity attacks fire only for melee foes (attack_range<=1) — use Corrupted Raider, not Bridge Warden.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issue observed. Design thesis 'button-mashing loses, tactics win' is empirically validated (0% naive vs 73% tactician win rate).
